source: 4. When should you use ZXNAME0000XZ instead of long-context prompting, fine-tuning, or continued pretraining? [Advanced - Judgment] Use ZXNAME0001XZ when the task depends on a corpus that is too large, too dynamic, too permission-sensitive, or too provenance-critical to place entirely in the prompt or model weights. Long-context prompting can be simpler when the relevant corpus is small enough to fit economically and the model can reliably use it. Fine-tuning is better suited to changing behavior, style, task competence, or learned patterns; it is a poor substitute for frequently changing factual records that must be updated or cited. Continued pretraining can adapt a model to a domain, but it also changes weights and does not give document-level provenance. There is no universal ZXNAME0002XZ-versus-long-context winner. A 2024 study found long context stronger on average under some sufficiently resourced settings, while the 2025 LaRA benchmark found the best choice depends on model, context length, task type, and retrieval characteristics. Route based on measured quality, cost, latency, freshness, and governance requirements. [26][27]
zh: 4. 什么时候应该使用 ZXNAME0000XZ 而不是长上下文提示、微调或继续预训练？ [高级 - 判断] 当任务依赖的语料库太大、太动态、权限太敏感或来源太关键而无法完全放入提示或模型权重时，请使用 ZXNAME0001XZ。当相关语料库足够小以经济地适合并且模型可以可靠地使用它时，长上下文提示可以更简单。微调更适合改变行为、风格、任务能力或学习模式；对于必须更新或引用的经常变化的事实记录来说，它是一个糟糕的替代品。持续的预训练可以使模型适应某个领域，但它也会改变权重并且不会给出文档级的出处。不存在通用的 ZXNAME0002XZ 与长上下文的胜利者。 2024 年的一项研究发现，在一些资源充足的设置下，长上下文平均更强，而 2025 年 LaRA 基准测试发现最佳选择取决于模型、上下文长度、任务类型和检索特征。基于测量的质量、成本、延迟、新鲜度和治理要求的路由。 [26][27]
